title: Staging rehearsal evidence pack definition
purpose: Define the evidence pack required before Test evidence can support staging-entry review beyond planning, without implementing schemas, validators, operator runbooks, staging infrastructure, or readiness claims.

nonClaims: This definition does not authorise staging execution.
This definition does not implement a handoff schema or validator.
This definition does not create a promotion runbook.
This definition does not claim staging readiness.
This definition does not claim production readiness.
This definition does not claim production-live proof.
This definition does not claim deployment readiness.

evidencePackScope.packPurpose: Support staging-entry review by making non-destructive production-shaped rehearsal evidence explicit, bounded, and lower-authority than semantic definitions and raw evidence.

requiredEvidenceClasses.purpose: Show that schema or data migration rehearsal expectations are recorded for staging-entry review without claiming production-live execution.
Show that release, rollback, and recovery paths are described with rollback boundaries and retained proof references.
Show that telemetry, alerting, and operator visibility expectations are captured for the rehearsal scope.
Show that incident triage, escalation, and failure-mode documentation are available for review.
Show that privacy, secret handling, access control, and security posture are represented for staging-entry review.
Show that backup, restore, and custody expectations are captured where proof claims depend on them.
Show that provider mode and environment are labelled separately and cannot upgrade each other by implication.
Show that raw evidence, generated reports, retained proof artifacts, and freshness states are distinguished.

forbiddenInterpretations: generated reports satisfying proof without raw evidence or retained proof artifacts
unknown, stale, missing, or mismatched evidence satisfying pass
staging-entry review being treated as staging readiness or deployment readiness
validationProofExpectation: Future schema or validator implementation must fail closed on missing required dimensions, unknown provider mode, unknown environment, stale evidence, missing custody, generated-report-only proof, or readiness overclaim.
Future Dev-to-Test and Test-to-Staging handoff records must remain separate implementation work and must reference this evidence-pack definition where applicable.
Future operator runbook work must sequence evidence collection without upgrading proof levels by implication.

openDependencies.reason: Dev-to-Test artifact handoff manifest schema and validator implementation remains open.
Test-to-Staging artifact handoff record schema and validator implementation remains open.
Environment ladder validator implementation remains open.
Promotion runbook and operator sequence remains open until handoff records, validator gates, and related proof evidence are available.
